name: Slite
shortDescription: Team docs with Ask, AI search and answers, at $10 per user billed yearly.
longDescription: Slite's pricing page lists $10 per user per month billed yearly and describes Ask as AI search and answers, plus a doc verification workflow. The $10 figure is not a month-to-month price.
